records.geographic_disambiguation: MTC original district maps establish the Río Iruro/Acarí corridor through Lucanas, San Juan, the eastern Chilques tributary junction, the San Pedro–Saisa valley, Acarí and Chaviña to the Pacific. component_scope_limits: The IGP report describes successive upstream names Intoncca, Iruro and San José before Acarí, with Pallpo and Chilques confluences marking stated name transitions.

The MTC road-map base labels Acarí farther upstream as well as Iruro in the northern valley. This is a source-scope difference; it does not justify assigning a uniform Acarí name to every selected reach.

The selected headward watercourse name and any actual passage through Laguna Huancaccocha remain null. Basin association, a nearby lake label and the general headwater prose are insufficient to establish that correspondence.
No name, Korean rendering, formal registry status or application change is accepted.

naming_scope_details.component_scope_limits: The selected route combines unnamed intermittent Park Canyon headwater drainage, an Alamo Creek/Wagon Road Canyon approach, the Cuyama River, Twitchell Reservoir, lower Cuyama and the Santa Maria River. Santa Maria River is supported as representative receiving-system identity only. Neither it nor Cuyama River is assigned to every component. Park Canyon is retained as a geographic canyon name, not asserted as a stream hydronym. Exact name-transition vertices remain unassigned.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes.
